_comment: Guía del robot A.R.I.A. (scripts/core/guide.gd). Textos CORTOS para niños de 7 a 12 años, en inglés (los ve el jugador): orientan, no explican todo. Cada lección sale UNA vez cuando ocurre su 'trigger': 'scene:<ruta>' al entrar a esa escena, 'task:<id>' al completar una tarea del día 1, 'all_tasks' al terminar las 4 y 'sol:2' al empezar el día 2, 'crops:ready' papas listas, 'lab:sample' hay una muestra para analizar, 'storm:warning' aviso de tormenta y 'storm:damage' algo que reparar tras una tormenta. {player} = nombre, {role} = profesión, {perk1}/{perk2} = ventajas. 'image' = captura del juego en assets/ui/guide/ (tools/build_guide_shots.py). 'routine' = lo que se revisa cada día en el botón de tareas (las papas tienen un texto por tarea del invernadero: plant, water, harvest, clear y dead). 'expedition' = los pasos que enseña la lista en AP-8 / AP-9. 'where' (opcional): 'base' o 'zone'; sin él, las lecciones de una escena salen allí y las demás solo en la base (si estás de expedición esperan a que vuelvas). SKIP TUTORIAL marca como vistas las lecciones del tutorial (entrar a un lugar, tareas del día 1 y all_tasks; las de AP-8/AP-9 no).

expedition.text: Wait for the sample (rest in your rover)

routine.dead: Dead plants: wait for the cycle to end

routine.todo: Get a check-up in the infirmary

pages.text: Hi {player}! I'm A.R.I.A. Click me anytime to see your tasks.
Your MAIN MISSION: collect ice SAMPLES and study them in the lab. Stay safe for 60 days!
Keep an eye on your bars. Don't let them get red!
First job: the storm broke the SOLAR PANELS. Let's go outside!
Walk with W A S D. Press E at a door. Go to the SOLAR PANELS!
Careful! Outside, RADIATION goes up 4 times faster. Do your job and go back inside quickly.
Click SOLAR FIELD and change the broken panels.
Fixed! Dust makes the panels dirty every day. Clean them daily.
Now go to the GREENHOUSE in the station.
Plant potatoes, then water them every day.
Nice! Now visit the GYM.
Run on the treadmill once a day to stay strong.
Day 1 done! Every day: clean panels, water potatoes, exercise, eat and sleep.
Hungry? Inside the station, click me and press EAT. Eat when your FOOD bar gets low!
Now the MAIN MISSION: collect ice SAMPLES and study them. That's how you win!
1. Drill ice at the ICE EXCAVATOR. 2. Take the sample to the WORK ROOM lab. 3. Drive the rover to AP-8 and AP-9 for more.
Is your RADIATION getting high? Get a check-up at the INFIRMARY body scanner.
Your superpower: {perk1}!
This is the ICE EXCAVATOR. Click the glowing console and drill an ice SAMPLE: it's the first part of your RESEARCH!
When you have the sample, take it to the WORK ROOM in the station.
WORK ROOM: click the glowing BIOSAFETY CABINET to prepare your ice sample. The lab analyzes it for 3 days while you do other things.
INFIRMARY: click the glowing BODY SCANNER for a check-up. It lowers your RADIATION. Come when that bar gets red!
CREW QUARTERS: sleep here when your TIREDNESS bar is high.
Your potatoes are ready! Harvest them in the GREENHOUSE.
You have an ice sample! Take it to the WORK ROOM to analyze it.
A dust storm is coming! Big storms keep you inside, and the panels make less power.
The storm hurt some systems. Open my list and fix them: 2 hours and 10 EU each.
AP-8 has big craters. Don't fall in!
1. Clean the dusty panels. 2. Use the ICE DRILL. Rest in the rover while it works.
AP-9 has ice mounds: lots of ice under the ground!
1. Clean the dusty panels. 2. Use the ICE DRILL. Rest in the rover while it works.
A new day! Dust covered the panels again. Clean them every day!
